widget.instructions: Press Play to watch the ball rise and fall.

args.text: At the top the ball stops for an instant: its height there is what was asked.

stem: A ball is thrown straight up at {{u}} m/s. Take g = 9.8 m/s² and ignore air resistance.
How high does it rise above the launch point?

hints.text: What is the ball's velocity at the highest point?
Use v² = u² − 2gh with v = 0 at the top.

missing-half-suvat.text: At the top v = 0, so 0 = u² − 2gh and h = u² ÷ (2g). You dropped the 2.

time-for-height.text: That is the time to reach the top, in seconds. The question asks how high.

dimension-mismatch.text: Check the unit: the answer is a length.

generic.text: At the top v = 0: h = u² ÷ (2g).

workedSolution.text: At the top the velocity is zero: 0 = u² − 2gh.

missing-half-suvat.front: Braking distance from u at deceleration a?
missing-half-suvat.back: u² ÷ (2a): the 2 comes from v² = u² + 2as.

time-for-height.front: Maximum height of a ball thrown up at u?
time-for-height.back: u² ÷ (2g); the time to the top is u ÷ g.

generic.front: Maximum height of a ball thrown up at u?
